input.quote: 10.1 On expiry or termination, Customer's right to access terminated subscription Services ends after any agreed transition period.
input.rationale: Section 10 (effect of expiry or termination) contains no transition-assistance or data return/export obligation: § 10.1 merely assumes "any agreed transition period" without obliging Vendor to provide one, § 10.2 addresses Deliverables and refunds only, and § 16.5 covers Confidential Information while expressly deferring Customer Data to Sections 11 and 15, neither of which imposes any return, export, or deletion-timing duty. Searches for transition, export/return, and deletion language found nothing else. In a hosting agreement this absence is a deviation, so we insert a single new § 10.3 at the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion after return.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.

proposal.summary: Insert § 10.3 requiring transition assistance and return then certified deletion of Customer Data on expiry or termination.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit clause: transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates, return of our Customer Data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion after return. Section 10 currently assumes "any agreed transition period" without obliging Vendor to provide one or to give our data back.

ops.text: On expiry or termination of this Agreement or an Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty days, return all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) after that return, delete Customer Data from its systems and certify the deletion to Customer in writing.
